UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private profile document for an authenticated Shop Daily Log owner.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified Gmail address (amdsolutionsqdn@gmail.com or registered Gmail account, PII, owner-only).

displayName.description: Display name shown in the signed-in workspace header.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace profile was last updated.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: A single daily shop/CSP accounting transaction entry belonging to a user.

id.description: Unique entry identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

date.description: Accounting log date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

orderIndex.description: Zero-based ordering position within the day's ledger.

serviceType.description: Service name or transaction classification (e.g., AEPS WITHDRAWAL).

remarks.description: Optional narration, customer reference, or remarks.

customDeltas.description: Optional explicit per-wallet delta overrides (ko, cash, fino, airtel, bank, credit).

lastModifiedByDeviceId.description: Optional per-session device identifier of the client that created or last updated the entry, enabling real-time remote-device change detection.

OpeningBalanceOverride.title: OpeningBalanceOverride
OpeningBalanceOverride.description: Manual opening balance snapshot override for a specific YYYY-MM-DD date.

date.description: Accounting date in YYYY-MM-DD format matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

NotificationReadState.title: NotificationReadState
NotificationReadState.description: Owner-private read cursor synchronizing which broadcast notifications the user has read across devices.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

lastReadAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the newest notification marked read by this user.

ActivityNotification.title: ActivityNotification
ActivityNotification.description: Immutable real-time change broadcast sent to all logged-in devices and accounts whenever any change occurs in the app (contains no PII).

id.description: Unique notification identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

actorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user whose device triggered the change.

actorName.description: Non-PII display name label of the actor.

deviceId.description: Per-session device identifier so receiving devices can distinguish remote vs local changes.

audience.description: Broadcast scope tag enforced by Firestore security rules.

summary.description: Concise human-readable description of the change.

targetDate.description: Affected ledger date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

ProjectOwnershipConfig.title: ProjectOwnershipConfig
ProjectOwnershipConfig.description: Project ownership configuration storing the designated Project Primary Owner (KO) and project animation settings.

primaryOwnerEmail.description: Designated Project Primary Owner (KO) Gmail address.

animationPreset.description: Selected project animation preset shown in the profile.

animationTitle.description: Optional short caption for the project animation.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who last updated the project animation.

SubKoRequest.title: SubKoRequest
SubKoRequest.description: Gmail verification and approval request for designating a Secondary Owner (Sub-KO), requiring explicit approval from the Project Primary Owner (KO).

id.description: Unique request identifier matching the document ID.

subKoEmail.description: Candidate Sub-KO Gmail address submitted via Verify Gmail.

requestedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user initiating the Sub-KO verification request.

requestedByName.description: Non-PII display label of the requester.

primaryOwnerEmail.description: Designated Project Primary Owner (KO) required to approve the request.

status.description: Verification workflow state (pending -> approved | declined, terminal once decided).

reviewedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Project Primary Owner (KO) who approved or declined the request (null while pending).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-private user profile and workspace root document.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Daily accounting ledger entries owned by userId, synchronized in real time.

/users/{userId}/openingOverrides/{dateKe.description: Per-date manual opening balance overrides owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/notificationState/{state.description: Owner-private notification read cursor synchronized across all of a user's devices.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Immutable cross-device and cross-account activity broadcast feed delivered in real time to all logged-in devices.

/projectConfig/{projectId}.description: Project ownership settings storing the immutable Project Primary Owner (KO) and project animation configuration.

/subKoRequests/{requestId}.description: Gmail verification requests for Secondary Owner (Sub-KO) roles pending explicit Primary Owner (KO) approval.
